references.text: Parallel text where God promises that the children whom the Israelites feared would become plunder will be allowed to enter the land
The Israelites complained that their children would become plunder, which God answers here
Describes a child who does not know how to reject evil and choose good, an expression similar to not knowing good and evil
God speaks of people who do not know the difference between right and left, a similar expression for innocent ignorance
The fulfillment of the promise that the new generation would inherit the land under Joshua
Paul refers to children who have not yet done good or evil, parallel to the concept of children who do not know good and evil
The context where God says that the wicked generation will not see the land, but Caleb will receive it
